newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Advtech confirms talks after shares surge.
newsitem.headline: Advtech confirms talks after shares surge.

text.p: Advanced Technical Systems (Advtech), the South African education group, confirmed on Friday it was in negotiations after its share soared to record highs in hectic trade on Thursday.
The company said it was in talks which could have an impact on its share price and urged shareholders to exercise caution in their dealings, but gave no further details in a brief announcement.
Advtech shares on Thursday hit a best ever level of 400 cents from a close of 305 on Wednesday on rumours it would announce a number of acquisitions as early as next week.
However, the shares, which have risen steadily from 26 cents at the beginning of the year, slipped back to end at 315 cents as players took profits.
Dealers said the firm, which has in recent months blazed an acquisition trail through the education and training industry, could add another four buys to its already handsome purchase list.

"There are another four deals in the pipeline...all in the education area. They are looking to buy three more campuses and launching the first Australian MBA degree in South Africa," one equity dealer told Reuters on Thursday.

Advtech has this year bought Mast Holdings Ltd, an education and training company, IMD Education Centres, which conducts education courses at tertiary level, and last month snapped up the Global School of Business.
